info.title: Annaba HR API
info.description: Identity, HR, leave, attendance and payroll. Sign in through the web application (session cookie); state-changing requests also need the X-CSRF-Token header. Errors use one envelope: { error: { code, message, fields?, requestId } }. Webhook payloads are described in docs/29-hr-webhooks.md.
